g.text: Separate user groups and extend a VLAN across two switches.
VLANs 100 and 101, access ports and four addressed hosts. The inter-switch trunk is left for the exercise.
Configure the trunk to carry VLANs 100 and 101; verify reachability and isolation.
L2 and host adapters. The wizard must declare the base VLANs and native VLAN.
